report_text: Piping crew completed spool erection on Line 24 in Unit 3 today. 4 joints fitted up and bolt-up in progress.
Line 24 | Piping | Unit 3 | Fit-up spool SP-045 | In-Progress | 04-Mar-2026
Completed final torqueing and bolt-up for Line 24 flanges at Unit 3 piperack interface. Ready for testing.
Conducted hydro testing on line 24-PP-1203 holding pressure at 24 bar for 4 hours. No pressure drop observed. Test passed.
Rigged and mounted 4-inch control valve CV-201 on the unit 3 piping run. Gasket seating verified.
Line 31 | Piping | Pipe Rack A | Erection of carbon steel pipe | Complete | 11-Mar-2026
Piping team completed butt weld joints W-01 through W-04 on the Line 31 pipe rack A extension.
X-ray testing team carried out NDT radiography for 6 joints on Line 31. Films sent for dark room processing.
Erection of 16-inch crude header line 52 inside tank farm commenced with 50T mobile crane.
Tank Farm | Piping | Line 52 | Tie-in Weld W-12 completed | Done | 23-Mar-2026
Filled Line 52 with test water for hydrostatic pressure test. Maintained required test pressure.
Fabricated and installed suction manifold piping connecting into crude pump P-101 in Unit 1.
Carried out laser dial alignment of discharge spools and flanges for feed pump P-101 in Unit 1.
Applied thermal insulation mineral wool and aluminum cladding across main steam headers in Unit 1.
Excavator completed pit excavation for foundation F-12 in Unit 3 down to -2.5m depth.
F-12 | Civil | Unit 3 | Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) pour | Done | 07-Mar-2026
Bar benders tied 2.8 MT of rebar cage for the footing F-12 at Unit 3. Inspection cleared by consultant.
Poured 34 cubic meters of M30 grade concrete into F-12 footing pit. Test cubes cast for curing.
Erected shuttering and cast vertical column C-7 with ready mix concrete at Unit 3 structure.
Cable Trench CT-01 | Civil | Pipe Rack A | Trenching and soil disposal | Completed | 05-Mar-2026
Masonry gang completed brick wall lining and plastering along both sides of cable trench CT-01 at Pipe Rack A.
Placed heavy precast RCC trench covers over cable duct CT-01 near Pipe Rack A.
Concreted heavy equipment plinth foundation for Pump P-101 in Unit 1 compressor house area.
Pump P-101 | Civil | Unit 1 | Non-shrink cementitious grouting baseplate | Complete | 16-Mar-2026
Reinforcement tying and concreting of containment dyke wall around Tank TK-102 finished today.
Paved 180 meters of heavy asphalt road between tank farm perimeter and pump house.
Rigged and bolted 250m of heavy gauge perforated cable trays along Unit 3 piperack tiers.
Pulled 450 meters of 11kV copper feeder cable through underground duct into Unit 3.
Cable jointers terminated high voltage 11kV stress cones inside unit 3 HT switchgear panel.
Erected structural steel gantry for main step-down power transformer TR-01 in Unit 1 yard.
Crew delayed by 1 day due to late crane arrival. Fit-up work on Spool SP-045 resumed in evening after crane setup.
Rain water accumulation in foundation F-12 pit delayed RCC pour by 24 hours. Dewatering pumps deployed.
Electrical gang delayed by 6 hours due to lack of work permit clearance for 11kV cable pull in Unit 3.
Overhauled diesel generator DG-04 starter motor in the utility substation shed.
Repaired boundary security lighting mast behind admin building parking lot.
